questions.questionText:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in
the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A. To think that a computer would one day replace a book is indeed unthinkable and
far fetched.
B.The thoughts and ideas contained in a book are immortal like Tulsidas’s Ram
Charitra Manas, Ved Vyas’ Mahabharata, The Bible and many other religious and
literary works like Shakespeare’s plays etc.
C.On the other hand a computer is but a machine, that at best can visually display the
contents of a specific book.
D.A good book in the words of John Milton “is the precious lifeblood of a master spirit,
embalmed and treasured up to a purpose to a life beyond life.”
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (B).
